lessons.role: Ask a local person about a route in a new town
lessons.opening: この みちを しっていますか。
objectives: Ask whether the person knows the route with しっていますか
Separate knowing the route from understanding the map with わかりますか
Ask whether the station can be reached alone with いけますか
lessons.complication: The person understands the map but does not know the route from memory.
lessons.closure: Confirm that the station is reachable with the map.

lessons.role: Choose between two shops with a companion
lessons.opening: この みせは あの みせより ちかいです。
objectives: Compare which shop is closer and which is quieter
Ask which shop is more convenient using どちら
Explain that the shop in front of the station is most convenient in town
lessons.complication: The quieter shop is farther away than the station shop.
lessons.closure: Name the shop you will visit and the reason for choosing it.

lessons.role: Pack a bag with a classmate before leaving
lessons.opening: ほんを かばんに いれます。
objectives: Name the book as the object being put in the bag with を
Add the pen and search for the keys
Report finding the keys and confirm whether they were packed
lessons.complication: The keys are missing when the bag is almost ready.
lessons.closure: Confirm that the keys are in the bag too.

lessons.role: Exchange notebooks and handouts with classmates
lessons.opening: わたしは ともだちに ノートを あげます。
objectives: Say what you give a friend with あげます
Say what a friend gives you with くれます
State what you received from the teacher and pass on to Aki
lessons.complication: The listener confuses who gives and who receives the copy.
lessons.closure: Confirm that Aki will read the materials later.

lessons.role: Meet a friend and offer help to a visitor at the station
lessons.opening: えきで ともだちに あいます。
objectives: Distinguish meeting a friend with に from calling that friend with を
Describe going over to the person who needs help
Offer to carry the bag and accept the visitor’s answer
lessons.complication: The visitor is having trouble with a bag while your friend arrives.
lessons.closure: Confirm that your friend will help too.

lessons.role: Invite a classmate to study at the library tomorrow
lessons.opening: あした、としょかんで べんきょうしませんか。
objectives: Invite the classmate with ～ませんか
Agree on two o’clock in the afternoon
Ask what happened yesterday and propose reading together tomorrow
lessons.complication: The classmate changes the topic briefly to yesterday before confirming the reading plan.
lessons.closure: Confirm that you will read together at the library.

lessons.role: Discuss last week’s visit with a classmate
lessons.opening: せんしゅう きょうとに いきましたか。
objectives: Ask whether the classmate went to Kyoto last week
Correct the assumption using ～ませんでした and name the friend’s town
Say the visit was not a trip and describe studying at the friend’s home
lessons.complication: The listener assumes the visit to the friend’s town was a holiday trip.
lessons.closure: Say that studying was fun and not difficult.

lessons.role: Contrast an old school journey with yesterday and now
lessons.opening: むかし、どうやって がっこうに いきましたか。
objectives: Describe often walking to school with a friend in the past
State that yesterday was one walk alone
Explain that you use the train now but sometimes still walk
lessons.complication: The listener treats the old repeated walk as the one event yesterday.
lessons.closure: Separate the old habit, yesterday’s event, and current routine.

lessons.role: Explain a library visit and a rainy-day train choice
lessons.opening: べんきょうしに としょかんへ いきます。
objectives: State the purpose of going to the library with ～しに
Explain reading for an exam with ～のために
Give rain as the reason for taking the train and confirm the 15:00 visit
lessons.complication: A partner asks why you are taking the train today rather than focusing on the library purpose.
lessons.closure: Confirm that you will go to the library at three in the afternoon.

lessons.role: Revise an outing plan with a friend because of rain
lessons.opening: きょうは ともだちと でかける よていでした。
objectives: State the original plan and contrast it with today’s rain using でも
Explain the decision not to go out using だから
Sequence the phone call and home study with それから and そして
lessons.complication: The friend asks whether the outing is canceled forever or only today.
lessons.closure: State that you plan to go out tomorrow.
